newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Someone was watching out for blind Dutch commuter.
newsitem.headline: Someone was watching out for blind Dutch commuter.

text.p: A young blind man fell under a Rotterdam metro train on Saturday and survived unharmed, Dutch police said on Sunday.
The 22-year-old stepped off a station platform into the gap between two carriages of the train, which he had mistakenly identified as an open door with his cane, the police said.
The train driver did not see the accident and drove away, but the man's fall left him rolled up against the base of the platform and out of the way of the wheels.
"He must have had an angel on his shoulder," the police commented.
